en: Colorized panoramic view of a European city with a steep, wooded hill rising from the middle. On top of the hill stands a fortified complex with walls and a prominent tower. Below are dense red‑roofed buildings and a large light-colored institutional building. A river with bridges curves through the city to the right, and distant mountains are faintly visible under a cloudy sky. The image has a painted/printed look and a white border typical of vintage postcards. No legible text appears on the front.
